tagline: Three days in the Serra Catarinense — choreographed around a baby's rhythm.

weather.note: Night frost · cutting wind up high

hero.alt: Pedra Furada · Morro da Igreja 1.827 m
hero.label: Morro da Igreja · Pedra Furada 1.827 m

babyRoutine.rule: Both adults must be back at the hotel with 20–30 min to spare before every nap. Every restaurant was chosen for being under 600 m from the hotel. Always keep emergency food (crackers, fruit, bottle) in the bag. Never bet on a single option without a plan B.

activities.title: Nap 1 · at home
activities.note: Baby sleeps at home. Use this window to load the car, fit the car seat and be ready at the door by 9 AM. Don't wake them — transfer carefully to the seat.

activities.title: Depart · start of trip
activities.note: Baby may finish Nap 1 in the moving car. Active window begins ~9:30. Keep stimulation simple: soft music, toys clipped to the seat. Avoid long stops — restarting motion can irritate a baby mid-window.

activities.title: Road snack
activities.note: Quick stop — petrol station, roadside bakery or food from home. Max 15–20 min. One adult refuels & uses the bathroom; the other feeds the baby in the back seat. Back in motion before noon.

activities.title: Nap 2 · moving car
activities.note: Keep driving continuously. Most babies fall asleep naturally with the car's motion. Don't stop for fuel or bathroom — plan that before noon. You should be arriving in the Urubici area during this window; if the baby is still sleeping at 14:00, circle the town or park quietly with the engine and heating on.

activities.title: Hotel check-in
activities.description: Check-in from 14:00. One adult enters to handle paperwork while the other stays with the baby (who may be finishing the nap). Ask for the crib to be assembled before arrival.

details.babyFriendly: Confirm crib assembled before arrival. Bottle warmer & audio monitor friendly.
tips: Ask for the cabin nearest the lodge — shortest walk with a baby & bags.
Confirm early crib setup by phone the day before.

activities.title: Baby adapts to room
activities.note: Let the baby explore the new space in-arms or safely on the floor for 15–20 min before any outing. New environment + tired baby = irritability if you rush straight out.

activities.title: Gruta N. Sra. de Lourdes
activities.description: A quiet, sheltered grotto behind a curtain of water. Temperature inside is stable against June's wind — one of the most comfortable spots in Urubici for a baby. Short flat walk.
activities.whyHere: Day 1 is a travel day — everyone is tired. The Gruta is the lowest-effort, highest-comfort outing: sheltered, calm, no long walk. Skip it entirely if the baby or adults are exhausted and just rest at the hotel.

image.alt: Gruta Nossa Senhora de Lourdes · waterfall shrine

details.accessibility: Flat short walk · no steps · carrier or arms
details.babyFriendly: Sheltered from wind · stable cool temperature · calm
tips: Optional — skip if tired. Can be moved to Day 2 afternoon without affecting the plan.

activities.title: Baby bedtime · evening routine
activities.note: Baby sleeps at 17:30. After routine: one adult goes to Artesabana (5 min walk) while the other stays with the audio monitor. Food is back in 15 min.

activities.title: Dinner · Artesabana Urubici
activities.description: After the baby is asleep, one adult walks 5 min to Artesabana and brings back dinner. Quick service — order and collect in 10–15 min. Perfect for a first night after a long travel day.
activities.whyHere: No restaurant dinner is viable with a 17:30 bedtime. Artesabana is the answer: fast, nearby, and the food travels well. The teal-painted room is warm and the caldos are exactly what you need on a June night.
whatToOrder: Arepa de Pernil com Banana da Terra
activities.logistics: Baby asleep 17:30. One adult leaves ~18:00–18:15. Order on arrival, collect in 10–15 min. Back at the hotel by 18:30 with dinner ready.

details.babyFriendly: Takeaway — baby stays at the hotel asleep
tips: Caldos warm up perfectly if the walk back is cold.
Confirm takeaway is available when you call ahead.

activities.title: Café Colonial · at the hotel

mapsPreview.title: Café Colonial at the hotel
mapsPreview.description: Book the upgrade the night before · 6:00–7:30 AM

activities.description: A loaded serra breakfast — artisan breads, serra-fruit jams (pinhão, blackberry, guava), cured meats, cheeses, cucas, herbal tea and hot chocolate. Served at the table, no driving required.
activities.whyHere: Day 2 is the most physical day (Morro da Igreja + Véu de Noiva). A calorie-dense breakfast fuels both adults without any extra stop. Book the upgrade with the pousada the evening before and ask for the 6:00–7:30 slot.
activities.logistics: Confirm with the pousada: 'Café colonial às 6h, para dois adultos.' Finish comfortably by 7:30 before Nap 1 at 8:00.

details.ticket: R$ 100 / couple — upgrade on the room rate
details.babyFriendly: Baby feeds normally; high chair available
tips: Confirm the early seating the night before — not every pousada serves this early by default.

activities.title: Nap 1 · hotel
activities.note: Pack the outing bag while the baby sleeps: carrier with wind cover, extra blanket, waterproof coat, emergency bottle, 3 h of diapers, photo ID for the Morro da Igreja checkpoint.

activities.title: Morro da Igreja · Pedra Furada

mapsPreview.title: Morro da Igreja · Pedra Furada
mapsPreview.description: SC-438 · 1.827 m · highest point in southern Brazil

activities.description: Panoramic viewpoint at 1.827 m with the iconic Pedra Furada arch. Reached by paved road. Front carrier with wind cover — no stroller on this terrain.
activities.whyHere: The signature view of the whole region. Keep the baby's wind exposure to 10–15 min max with full coverage. The drive up is half the experience — sea of clouds below, frost on the grass.
activities.logistics: Leave hotel 9:30. Drive ~20–25 min (SC-438). Arrive 9:50–9:55. Start heading back by 11:10–11:15 to reach Bodegão at 11:30.

image.alt: Pedra Furada · rock arch at 1.827 m

details.ticket: Advance permit (visitor cap) · bring photo ID for the checkpoint
details.parking: Lot at the gate · short walk to the platform
details.accessibility: Uneven rocky ground — carrier only, no stroller
details.babyFriendly: Thermal bodysuit + wind cover essential. Never leave the baby in open wind >10–15 min.
tips: Book the permit days before — the daily cap fills up.
Check road conditions (frost possible at night) before departing.

activities.title: Almoço · Bodegão
activities.description: Urubici's most-reviewed restaurant — full serra menu, consistent quality. The right place for the trip's main midday meal.
activities.whyHere: 1.984 reviews signal real consistency. Order the moment you sit — no starters, no dessert. If there's a wait over 5 min or the place is packed, activate Plan B immediately: Artesabana (Av. Rodolfo Anderman 675, ~500 m, under 10 min service).
activities.logistics: Arrive 11:30–11:35. Order on sitting. Out by 12:00. Walk back to hotel 3–10 min. Baby in the crib at 12:00 sharp for Nap 2.

details.ticket: R$ 100–140 for two · Plan B: Artesabana
details.accessibility: Step-free, ask for a table at the back
tips: Order the moment you sit — the 12:00 nap is non-negotiable.
Plan B without hesitation if there's any wait: Artesabana is 500 m away.

activities.title: Nap 2 · hotel
activities.note: The longest rest block of the trip. Adults recharge by the fireplace. Both of you will need it — Morro da Igreja is cold and tiring.

activities.title: Cascata Véu de Noiva
activities.address: Estrada Véu de Noiva, Urubici — SC

mapsPreview.title: Cascata Véu de Noiva
mapsPreview.description: ~8–12 km from centro · short walk · baby-friendly

activities.description: A veil of water on a short, mostly flat trail — one of the most family-accessible falls in the region. Wooden boardwalk to the lower deck, good for a carrier.
activities.whyHere: High visual reward, low physical demand — the right balance for a baby and tired adults on an afternoon after the big morning. Pair with the snack restaurant on the access road.

image.alt: Cascata Véu de Noiva · waterfall with wooden bridge

details.accessibility: Boardwalk to lower deck; carrier past that
details.babyFriendly: Wrap the carrier — mist reaches the lower deck
tips: Combine with the snack restaurant on the access road (Restaurante Véu de Noiva) — no detour needed.

activities.title: Snack · Restaurante Véu de Noiva
activities.address: Estrada de acesso · Cascata Véu de Noiva, Urubici

mapsPreview.title: Restaurante Véu de Noiva
mapsPreview.description: On the access road · rustic · farofa de pinhão

activities.description: Rustic home cooking right on the access road. Famous for one thing: farofa de pinhão — the serra's signature dish, worth trying at least once on the trip.
activities.whyHere: You had lunch at noon. After the waterfall walk, a warm snack bridges the gap before the 17:00 drive back. Eat 15:30–16:00, leave by 16:30 to reach the hotel at 17:00.
activities.logistics: Eat on-site after the waterfall. Leave by 16:30 — the hotel is 15–20 min away. Bedtime routine starts at 17:30.

image.alt: Restaurante Véu de Noiva · forest terrace

details.accessibility: Rural, simple, easy with a carrier
tips: The farofa de pinhão is the reason to stop — don't skip it.

activities.title: Evening routine + hotel dinner
activities.note: Arrive hotel 17:00 with 30 min margin. Baby asleep 17:30. Adults' dinner: room service, hotel restaurant, or takeaway fetched after bedtime.

activities.title: Hotel breakfast · included
activities.note: Standard included breakfast. Use this window to pack fully, load the car and have everything done before Nap 1 at 8:00. The car must be loaded by 8 AM — there's no time after.

activities.title: Nap 1 · hotel
activities.note: Baby's last hotel nap. Adults do final room check, return keys, confirm check-out. Check-out at 9:30 — baby goes straight from the crib to the car seat.

activities.title: Check-out · 9:30 AM
activities.note: Mandatory check-out by 11:00 — done at 9:30 to preserve the morning window. Car already loaded. Baby straight from crib to car seat. Drive ~8–10 min to Cascata do Avencal.

activities.title: Cascata do Avencal · upper decks

mapsPreview.title: Cascata do Avencal
mapsPreview.description: Morro do Avencal, Urubici · ~100 m fall · upper decks only

activities.description: Stay on the upper decks and viewpoints only — the lower trail has steep wet steps. From the top, the ~100 m fall is completely accessible and striking.
activities.whyHere: A short, high-impact view on the way out — only 3–5 km from the hotel and on the same road as Guardião. 25–30 min, then continue to the last stop.

image.alt: Cascata do Avencal · 100m fall from the upper deck

details.accessibility: Upper decks only — skip the lower trail with a baby
details.babyFriendly: Stay behind the rails at the upper platforms · carrier
tips: Combine immediately with Guardião do Avencal — just 1–2 km further on the same road.

activities.title: Last stop · Guardião do Avencal
activities.address: SC-110, Km 380 — Morro do Avencal, Urubici

mapsPreview.title: Guardião do Avencal
mapsPreview.description: SC-110, Km 380 · ★ 4.5 (154) · café + rock art + animals

activities.description: A private estate combining café colonial with ancestral cave paintings, a valley overlook and a small animal farm. Urubici's most complete single experience — and literally on the same road.
activities.whyHere: The last outing of the trip. Attraction + food in one place, no extra driving, baby-friendly pace. Rock art + animal farm make it more stimulating for the baby than any restaurant.
activities.logistics: Arrive 10:15. Viewpoints + rock art ~30–35 min. Café colonial ~20–25 min. Depart 11:00–11:10. Drive to highway ~12–15 min. In motion by 11:30.

image.alt: Guardião do Avencal · ancestral rock paintings

details.babyFriendly: Slow pace · animals · minimal effort · calm café
tips: The rock art panels are fenced but very readable — explain to the baby with pointing, they respond to it.
Book a table ahead if arriving on a weekend.

activities.title: Depart Urubici · homeward
activities.note: Leave before 11:30 with comfort. Baby still in the active window — soft music, toys. In motion by 11:30.

activities.title: Nap 2 · moving car
activities.note: Keep driving continuously. The baby will fall asleep naturally. Don't stop — plan any fuel or bathroom before noon.

activities.title: Baby wakes · final stretch
activities.note: Quick stop if needed (diaper, bottle). Resume and head home — trip complete, baby rested, no schedule broken.

alerts.title: It's genuinely cold
alerts.body: June in Urubici runs 0–10°C with night frost and cutting wind at altitude. The baby needs a thermal bodysuit, wool snowsuit, waterproof coat and an emergency blanket. Never expose them to open wind for more than 10–15 min at high spots like Morro da Igreja.

alerts.title: No restaurant dinners
alerts.body: With a 17:30 bedtime there's no window for a sit-down dinner. All dinners happen at the hotel — room service, in-house, or takeaway fetched by one adult after the baby sleeps (with the audio monitor on).

alerts.title: Lunch strategy
alerts.body: Practical play: one adult fetches takeaway while the other stays with the sleeping baby. When the restaurant is under 600 m, both can go if the baby is deeply asleep and the audio monitor is on. Always adapt to the day.

alerts.title: Book ahead
alerts.body: Bodegão and Guardião do Avencal have high demand on weekends. Call or reserve online before leaving home. Also confirm the café colonial time with your pousada the evening before Day 2.
